SELECT e.enterprise_id, e.com_acct_name, e.com_acct_code, COALESCE(m.role, 'MEMBER') AS role, COALESCE(m.status, 'ACTIVE') AS status, CASE WHEN e.enterprise_id = 1 THEN 'READY' WHEN mode.params_value = 'TRIAL' THEN 'READY' WHEN provision.params_value IS NULL THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"READY"%' THEN 'READY' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"RESERVED"%' THEN 'RESERVED' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"DB_CREATING"%' THEN 'DB_CREATING' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"ADMIN_ONLY"%' THEN 'ADMIN_ONLY' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"REDIS_PUBLISHED"%' THEN 'REDIS_PUBLISHED' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"FAILED"%' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN REPLACE(provision.params_value, ' ', '') LIKE '%"status":"MANUAL_REQUIRED"%' THEN 'MANUAL_REQUIRED' ELSE 'UNAVAILABLE' END AS provision_state FROM po_enterprise_info e LEFT JOIN tenant_user_membership m ON m.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN tenant_config provision ON provision.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND provision.params_code = 'PROVISION_STATE' LEFT JOIN tenant_config mode ON mode.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND mode.params_code = 'TENANT_MODE' LEFT JOIN tenant_config creation ON creation.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id AND creation.params_code = 'PROVISION_REQUEST_ID' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT enterprise_id, MIN(joined_at) AS created_at FROM tenant_user_membership GROUP BY enterprise_id ) legacy_creation ON legacy_creation.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} OR e.enterprise_id = 1
ORDER BY COALESCE(creation.created_at, legacy_creation.created_at) DESC NULLS LAST, e.enterprise_id DESC
